components.name: macos.roc, the roc-native-macos app author's tool
Polymorphic Defunctionalization Through Lambda Set Specialization (the starter's default song and its timed lyrics)

relationships.basis: macos-<hash>.tar.zst is the tool's package: the modules of cli/, a Bundle.roc that scripts/release.roc generates naming the release, the starter scaffold copied from every tracked file of examples/starter (whose fuzz/main.roc names roc-fuzz 0.7.0's platform by URL; it is fetched only when an app builds its fuzz targets, and is not in the package), LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. macos.roc is the small app, generated by scripts/release.roc, that names that package.
macos.roc and the package's header name basic-cli 0.28.1 by its content-addressed URL; the compiler fetches it when the tool runs, and it is not in either file.
Bundle.roc names the platform bundle of the same release, which `init` writes into a new app's header; the compiler fetches it when that app builds.

The starter scaffold in the tool's package carries the default song, assets/polymorphic-defunctionalization.mp3, and its timed lyrics, under CC BY 4.0, not the UPL; `init` copies them, with assets/CREDITS.md attributing them, into every new app.

coverage.reason: The archive is written by scripts/release.roc on roc-stable and zip, and the tool's package by roc bundle on the latest Roc nightly at release time; the release notes name both compilers under Compilers. Neither adds code of its own.
